0022600110.text: The Pelicans (0-2, 4th in the Southwest and 10th in the West) are on a two-game losing streak and visit the Nuggets (0-1, 11th in the West), who are also still searching for their first win. New Orleans is 0-1 on the road, and Yves Missi is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), all listed as out, and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pelicans lost all three games to Denver, the most recent a 122-116 loss in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
